body: vterm.go: handleEsc() handles ESC ] ... BEL and ESC ] ... ESC \ (ST-terminated) OSC sequences. handleOSC() parses 0/1/2;title → Screen.Title. GetTitle() accessor. main.go: win.SetTitle() updated each render tick from screen.GetTitle(). TextInput event snaps ScrollReset() before writing to PTY. TestOSCWindowTitle: BEL-terminated, ST-terminated, mid-stream OSC all pass. 18 vterm tests total.
